title: Rational Superautotrophic Diplomacy (SupraAD): A Conceptual Framework for Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI models using standardized scenarios (e.g., resource allocation dilemmas, multi-agent negotiations, zero-sum games) and automated reasoning trace analysis to detect implicit assumptions favoring winner-take-all, adversarial, or zero-sum approaches over collaborative, positive-sum solutions.
